== Notes ==
* Consider using with [[Water Magic#Skills related to Water Magic hexes|skills that require a Water Magic hex]] for a decent [[spike]], such as [[Freezing Gust]].
* Unlike [[Incendiary Bonds]], [[Lightning Strike]], and [[Lightning Surge]], removing Shatterstone prematurely using a [[List of hex removal skills|hex removal skill]] will still trigger the [[end effect]] damage.
* The additional damage will occur if the target dies before the hex expires.
